property_summary: For any fuzzed bytes4 id, if the contract reports support for the IAccessControl interface id, then it must also report support for the ERC165 (IERC165) interface id via the super fallback; the mutant drops the fallback and so fails this implication for every input.
change_summary: Return only true for the IAccessControl interface id, dropping the super.supportsInterface fallback so IERC165 is no longer reported as supported.
